title: AirVape Legacy PRO Portable Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
The already great Airvape Legacy gets a Pro upgrade

After the release of Legacy, Airvape got together with a new engineer and design team and spent 2 years perfecting each detail

The result is the meticulously crafted and carefully curated Legacy PRO

The curved edges make the PROs shape much sexier. The matte black finish with full black textile and leather with the gold accent also complement the look that hides the high standard of technology inside.

New features:
Built-in Microdosing Disk
Upgraded Structure and Hinges
More Powerful battery
20% bigger chamber

BONUS ITEMS – 4 PIECE PREMIUM GRINDER, 2 CLEANING STICKS, 1 BRUSH

Legacy PRO Features:
– Used for Loose-leaf and Oil Concentrates
– Vibration signal
– Heat-up Time: 15 Seconds to Optimal Vaping Temp
– Two-button precise temperature control ↑↓ from 212F to 464F
– Ceramic Mouthpiece
– Removable glass AirPath
– Gold plated heating Chamber + Gold Plated Microdosing disk
– Measurements: 119 mm x 52 mm x 21
– Materials: Hemp-based textile, Vegan leather, Black ceramic, 24K gold plating, Glass

What’s in the Box:
AirVape Legacy PRO + 18650/3200 mAh Legacy PRO Removable Battery
Concentrates Pad Insert
USB-C Charger Cable
Cleaning, Loading Tools
Replacement Filter Screens
